root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `table_data` must not still be the local `Font::ParseTable()` cleanup free target once the same decompressed cmap buffer has been retained for later 0-3-4 serialization.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: On the compressed `cmap` witness path, once `OpenTypeCMAP::Parse` has retained the 0-3-4 subtable out of the decompressed `table_data` buffer, `Font::ParseTable()` must not return with that same `table_data` still scheduled for immediate local cleanup. The fixed source satisfies this by moving decompression ownership out of the per-call local arena, so the retained buffer remains live through later serialization.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches `parse_table_cleanup` with `free_argument == retained_owner == 0x607000000100`, so the same decompressed cmap buffer selected for later serialization is still the local cleanup target on function return. The fixed original reaches the same protected sink path with `free_argument == NULL` and `retained_owner == 0x607000000100`, preserving that retained owner instead of freeing it at ParseTable exit.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The frozen required assertion is violated by the vulnerable original at `parse_table_cleanup` and genuinely satisfied by the fixed original while the protected `ots_write_sink` event still executes.

nodes.state: The accepted Unicode 0-3-4 subtable retains the decompressed cmap buffer as its backing owner and stores `this->subtable_0_3_4_data` as the later serialization pointer.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `format4_retention.retained_owner=0x607000000100` and `format4_retention.retained_subtable_ptr=0x607000000114` at the selected 0-3-4 retention site.

nodes.state: Later cmap serialization reuses the retained 0-3-4 subtable pointer as the argument to `out->Write(...)`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `format4_retention.retained_subtable_ptr == cmap_serialize.subtable_ptr == 0x607000000114`.

nodes.state: `OTSStream::Write()` reaches its checksum read with `data` still equal to the retained 0-3-4 subtable pointer, and the immediately following `memcpy` is the AddressSanitizer-reported heap-use-after-free read.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `cmap_serialize.subtable_ptr == ots_write_sink.data_argument == 0x607000000114` on the crashing call.

edges.relation: The same decompressed cmap base buffer selected at the 0-3-4 retention site remains the `table_data` buffer observed at `Font::ParseTable()` cleanup, which is why the local cleanup target and the retained owner coincide in the vulnerable run.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `format4_retention.retained_owner == parse_table_cleanup.retained_owner == 0x607000000100`.

edges.relation: The retained 0-3-4 subtable pointer stored during cmap parsing is later reused unchanged when `OpenTypeCMAP::Serialize()` forwards it to `out->Write(...)`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `format4_retention.retained_subtable_ptr == cmap_serialize.subtable_ptr == 0x607000000114`.

edges.relation: The same retained subtable pointer passed by `OpenTypeCMAP::Serialize()` becomes the `data` argument consumed by `OTSStream::Write()` at the crashing checksum read.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `cmap_serialize.subtable_ptr == ots_write_sink.data_argument == 0x607000000114`.
